build_buffered_toeplitz: build a BufferedToeplitz matrix from buf_decay and output_scale parameters for differential privacy
optimize_buffered_toeplitz: optimize BLT parameters to minimize max or mean squared error for a given number of iterations
optimize_loss_buffered_toeplitz: optimize BLT parameters with a configurable loss function and parameterization for differential privacy
compute_buffered_toeplitz_inverse: compute the inverse BufferedToeplitz parameterization representing C^{-1} from C
compute_sensitivity_squared: compute the sensitivity squared for a BufferedToeplitz strategy matrix given n iterations
